newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Subscription to Hoogovens bond closes 1300 gmt tod.
newsitem.headline: Subscription to Hoogovens bond closes 1300 gmt tod.

text.p: Subscriptions to the 300 million guilder 10 year subordinated convertible bond issue from steel and aluminium group Koninklijke Hoogovens NV will close early because of strong demand, ABN AMRO Bank NV said on Wednesday.
The issue will close today at 1300 GMT. Originally, the close had been planned for April 18.
ABN AMRO said demand had come from both the Netherlands and abroad. It will announce the final terms of the issue before the start of trading on April 17.
On Tuesday, Hoogovens said the coupon of the convertibles was expected to be between 4.5 and 4.875 percent.
It added it would use the proceeds from the issue to strengthen its capital structure and competitive position.
Hoogovens said the issue could be increased through a "greenshoe option" by a maximum of 15 percent, which would raise the proceeds to 345 million guilders.
